findings.evidence: Lines 182–300 use `ExactK0 (E.fullSubcategory P hP)` only; lines 323–413 additionally use `ExactK0` of `(E.admitsFiniteResolution P).FullSubcategory`. Mathlib defines `ObjectProperty.EssentiallySmall`, and ObjectProperty.lean:106–108 explicitly shows ambient smallness is merely one sufficient way to obtain it.
findings.fix: Replace the ambient assumption with `[P.EssentiallySmall]` for the Euler-class layer and add `[(E.admitsFiniteResolution P).EssentiallySmall]` only for the resolution-theorem section.
findings.issue: The file-wide `[EssentiallySmall C]` is stronger than required: declarations through `eulerClassOf_congr` only form `ExactK0` of `P.FullSubcategory`, while the resolution theorem additionally uses the finite-resolution full subcategory.

summary: The new Euler-class API imposes essential smallness on the ambient category even though only the relevant full subcategories must be essentially small.
